revision.description: A full commit sha, never a branch or tag, so the sync follows a reviewed commit.

autoscaling.description: Set by kore only while autoscaling-defaults is on (ADR 0047). The sync then sets autoscaling.enabled on each workload, so its chart renders the HorizontalPodAutoscaler and no replica count. Off, the sync sets no such parameter.

serviceRecords.description: Set by kore only while platform-portal, platform-organization-service-apis and platform-argocd-delivery are all on (ADR 0166). The sync then also applies each registration's Service record to the cluster, and the Service composition, not the sync, creates each app namespace. Off, the sync creates the namespace itself and applies no records.

recordsPath.description: The directory of the Service spec files the records Application syncs (ADR 0166).

sharedGateway.description: Labels each app namespace the sync creates with the platform-owned shared-gateway label, so the shared Gateway admits its routes (ADR 0133). Off, the sync sets no namespace metadata.

templateAdmission.description: Set by kore only while golden-path-template-admission is on (ADR 0181). The sync then labels each app namespace it creates with policy.sigstore.dev/include, so the golden-path namespaces are enrolled by their creator. Off, the sync sets no such label.

signin.description: Set by kore only while golden-path-signin is on (issue 1746). The sync then passes signin.enabled and this issuer to each workload, which renders its Keycloak client and the BFF's sign-in variables. Off, the sync sets no such parameter.

ingress.description: HTTPS for each Service's default host. Without it the Applications carry no ingress parameter.

sharedGateway.description: The shared platform Gateway each Service's route also attaches to, which kore passes only while platform-shared-gateway is on (ADR 0133). Without it the Applications carry no shared Gateway parameter.

domain.description: The platform organization's domain, <organizationId>.<platformDomain>, which the shared Gateway's wildcard listener serves.

digest.description: The signed sha256 digest recorded in the template lock.
